summary: All 6 UI-facing acceptance criteria exercised via named browser checks; all passed. No API-bearing criterion required a dedicated backend test file (catalogue GET is pre-existing read-only data powering the UI criteria, already exercised indirectly through the browser checks and a direct curl probe).

checks.criterion: Navigating from a scrolled catalogue page into any individual product page resets the new page to its top
checks.name: scroll-resets-on-product-nav
checks.evidence: Scrolled /books to scrollY>200, clicked 'The First Table', landed on /books/the-first-table with window.scrollY<=10 and hero visible.

checks.criterion: All normal route navigation resets to the top while explicit in-page anchors remain supported
checks.name: route-nav-top-and-anchor-scroll
checks.evidence: Scrolled /about to y=400, clicked nav Home link, Home loaded at scrollY<=10; then clicked hero-primary-cta (in-page anchor) and #collection section ('featured-collection-section') came into viewport.

checks.criterion: The product page has a visually emphasized price treatment
checks.name: product-price-panel-emphasis
checks.evidence: product-price-panel background rgb(234,223,205) (champagne #eadfcd); product-selling-price text '₹249' color rgb(122,92,50) (#7a5c32); product-original-price text '₹499' present and correct, matching seed facts.

checks.criterion: Product-page interactions feel subtly animated rather than abrupt
checks.name: product-page-animations-present
checks.evidence: Route transition into product page rendered; progress-meter fill bar visible (motion width animation element present); Contents toggle aria-expanded false->true with TOC content appearing ('The Idea'); price panel hover kept panel visible/usable.

checks.criterion: The Inside the Book contents control animates open and closed
checks.name: toc-toggle-open-close
checks.evidence: product-toc-toggle aria-expanded toggled false->true->false; product-toc-list appeared with 'The Idea' & 'Restaurant field workbook', then unmounted (count 0) after second click.

checks.criterion: The updated product experience remains usable on mobile
checks.name: product-page-mobile-usable
checks.evidence: Run against public preview URL at 390x844 viewport: title/price-panel/buy buttons visible, documentElement.scrollWidth <= clientWidth+2 (no horizontal overflow) before and after opening Contents and scrolling to progress meter.
